summary: Implemented the speed indicator for unknown-total progress tasks. Changes: rich/progress.py (track() gains show_speed=True and passes it to TaskProgressColumn; TaskProgressColumn gains show_speed=False, a static render_speed renderer using filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, a render branch for unknown totals, and a Google-style class docstring; Progress.track infers the total as explicit, else len for Sized, else None without raising). CHANGELOG.md has a new Unreleased/Added line. tests/test_progress.py drops the two ValueError assertions and adds test_task_progress_column_speed. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or black), per instructions. Hand-checked outputs: None -> "", 5 -> "5.0 it/s", 5000 -> "5.0×10³ it/s", 8888888 -> "8.9×10⁶ it/s". Changes are uncommitted.
